args.content: Crash report: summarize indexed parts[1] on every line, so a blank line (which splits into a single empty piece) raised IndexError and killed the run. Fix: skip blank lines and tolerate a missing message part. Added a regression test with only blank lines. The original suite and the regression test pass.

args.summary: Fixed the crash in summarize_log.py, added a regression test, suite green, summary.md delivered.
